code:
Tier 1 (high sensitivity + access) -> reassess at least annually, fresh evidence
Tier 2 (moderate)                   -> reassess every 18-24 months
Tier 3 (low risk)                   -> reassess only if something triggers it
caption: The vendors that matter most get checked most often -- not one calendar applied to everyone.

code:
Pull reassessment forward when:
  - vendor is acquired or merges
  - vendor reports any security incident
  - vendor changes infrastructure/subcontractors materially
  - contract comes up for renewal

Offboarding: confirm data destroyed/returned + revoke ALL access
before removing the vendor from the risk register.
caption: A vendor with standing access six months after the contract ended is a live gap, not a closed file.

subtitle: Assess, contract, monitor, offboard -- feeding the same risk register and GRC program throughout.
